E0761

Unknown `#Context` field name (v1 allows only `allocator`, `logger`, `deadline`)

What

Unknown `#Context` field name (v1 allows only `allocator`, `logger`, `deadline`)

Why

The registered parser rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0761

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0761: tests/ui/context_unknown_field.stderr.

Error [E0761]: `scheduler` isn't a context field
  --> tests/ui/context_unknown_field.jet:7:14
    |
  7 |     #Context(scheduler: arena) {
    |              ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: the context bundle holds `allocator`, `logger`, and `deadline`
 Fix: write `#Context(allocator: …)`, `#Context(logger: …)`, or `#Context(deadline: …)`
